race.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Bet 10 Get 50' Tara Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: PADDY'S MILESTONE scored with something in hand in this race last year and he is fancied to land the prize again given his good record fresh. He gets the vote ahead of Mart Lane , who took another step forward when opening his account at Listowel, while Cool Native remains capable of better as she goes handicapping. PADDY'S MILESTONE (IRE) MART LANE (IRE) COOL NATIVE (IRE)
